notes: Idea: find a constant bias in the open-tennis-robots launch fit. Cause: two ball masses (57.0 g fit/config/CAD vs 57.7 g flight model/simulator; ratio 1.0123). Probe: measured/predicted drop 1.004-1.015 flat at every speed, so a scale factor. Fixed to one mass with a test. Then: wheels under 1,000 rpm set aside (3 revs before the verdict, 54-78% of the drop read; drove a 1.41 m outlier), Refitter speed_tol 5% to 2%. Sweeps (simulator only): speed eff worst 1.9% to 0.6%; spin worst 6.6% to 7.7% (worse, open); refit worst shot 0.74 to 0.34 m; tol sweep builds 2.4-3.5% off went from about 1 m to 0.11 m or less.
